notes.title: CUAYDv22!
notes.content:
We remixed down the game to include options that you can customize / rebind keys on keyboard and on controller.

Thank you for the support and hope you have an amazing day / evening!


-Necro-

notes.title: Version 22 Now OUT!
notes.content:
We updated the game to include :

-Spelling error after beating final boss in the Forest Dungeon.

-Added Item Book, can be found at the Shop.

-Adjusted Super Ball that you can only use it once. Before you could spam it and level up to level 99! 

THANK YOU ALL FOR PLAYING! 

The game goes off sale ( 10% ) tomorrow! 



-Necro-

notes.title: v21 Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Today we updated the game with a new costume for The Girl called "Red Raver". You can find it in the costume shop for 50 g. 

We also programmed to show The Girl hold the weapons in battle.

Updated the game to include a icon on the Enemy Book.

THANK YOU ALL FOR MAKING THE GAME'S LAUNCH A SUCCESS!

"Clean Up After Your Dog" is still 10% off until the 7th of Feb!

Appreciate your ongoing support, thank you again!


-Necro-
--NecroCaticGames--

notes.title: v20 is out!!
notes.content:
You can now get the dog to lead your party with FORMATION!

You can spend 5 seconds and pick fruit! If you consume the fruit you will gain 10 HP.

THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT, we are excited to release the game in a couple days!

-NECRO-
--NECROCATIC GAMES--

notes.title: CUAYD v16
notes.content:
Here is a small list of things we changed in the game.

-We added some music from Swedish Wargoat to the snow level, world map, shop and forest!

-Added that the default selection for mining is set to option 1.

-Added sound effect to open and close the blinds.



THANK YOU for your support!


-Necro-
--NecroCaticGames--

notes.title: Small Game Update!!
notes.content:
Today we added KEYBOARD and CONTROLLER configuration so you can map the keys however you want!!

For the keyboard, the game developer suggests the WASD layout and then that also features ARROW key movement for your character. 

I hope you are having a great day!!



-Necro-

notes.title: 14th Patch of CUAYD!
notes.content:
We changed the following in the 14th patch of "CLEAN UP AFTER YOUR DOG":

-Added markers showing places you can interact with on the world map.

-Added 13 Trading Cards to collect (buy from the card guy at the shop!)

-Adjusted some tiles that you cannot go through.

-More places to inspect!



Happiest Holidays, my friends!! 



-Necro-
